lens: APP FEASIBILITY AND SAFETY (adversarial verifier, label verify-4-feasibility)
rule: 6 h trap guard (today 24 h) plus skip when the book page's own edge (ab_checkEv) is 1 point or more under the list's edge (ev); universe: shown, ev>=2.5%, -200..+130, PROP/MONEYLINE/SPREAD, first listed within 24 h, book page read (builder's UJ)
numbers_reproduced: MATCHES the builder on every headline. Rule keeps 39 of 75 bets, 20 of 28 games, 17.29 a day over 2.256 days; CLV on 34 closes/18 games +3.30% [+2.04,+4.75] (builder [+2.03,+4.76], seed only), 79% beat, close_ok 31 closes +3.33%; ROI -11.8% on 38 settled; universe 64 closes/25 games +1.38% [-0.04,+3.06]; dropped 36 bets, 30 closes/17 games -0.79% [-3.86,+1.92]. Halves by the shared loader split (cut Oct 4): first 26 closes/14 games +2.94% [+1.48,+4.76], second 8 closes/4 games +4.46% (the builder's 3.62/3.12 do not reproduce under that split). Dollar claims reproduce: placeable set 47 bets (20.8/day) -> 30 (13.3/day); $97.4 -> $62.9 a day at a $5 cap, $41.9 -> $27.1 at quarter-Kelly (cap $3.50); CLV$ 1.14 -> 1.92 a day at the $5 cap. NEW, from my lens: (1) the 75-bet universe is not what the app can place: 28 of 75 fail the app's own rules (3+ agree 15, sharp VETOED 17, book-check EV<=0 6, <2 two-sided 3; union 28). On the 47 placeable bets the rule keeps 30 bets/15 games, 29 closes +3.12% [+1.68,+4.55] vs placeable baseline 45 closes/21 games +1.14% [-0.58,+3.16]; dropped 17 bets/13 games, 16 closes -2.44% [-7.10,+2.03]. (2) The falling-edge half touches 2 of those 47 (2 games, CLV -1.52%): 11 of the 13 first-look flagged bets are already refused by the app (agree<3 or vetoed). The 6 h guard alone on the placeable set: 32 bets/17 games, 31 closes +2.82% [+1.42,+4.24]. (3) The app decides at decision time, not first look: of 57 real auto-bets in the study window that match a study bet, only 20 (35%) are in the first-look universe; 37 were first listed under 2.5% (mean 1.99%) and were placed later at 3.35% (median wait 9 min, mean 83; 23 of 57 at a better price). Real executed CNO auto-bets in the window (Oct 3 17:56 to Oct 5 19:57 ET, 62 bets, 29 games, $104.5 staked = 27.5 bets and $46.3 a day): <=6 h at placement 28 bets/14 games CLV +2.54% [+1.15,+4.19]; >6 h 34 bets/20 games +1.68% [+0.19,+3.18]; gap +0.87 pts [-1.16,+3.29], P(gap<=0)=0.19; the rule keeps 27 bets (+2.59% [+1.13,+4.19]) and drops 35 (+1.67% [+0.24,+3.09]); it drops 35 of 62 bets (56%) and $60.6 of $104.5 staked (58%); the falling-edge clause flags 2 of 62 (3 of 99 incl. Oct 2; CLV +0.95%). Realized CLV$ a day: all $0.945, kept $0.560, dropped $0.386 (dropping them loses 41% of it). (4) Decision-time simulation from the study's looks (list presence from c looks, page from k looks, check EV re-priced at each look's price, current rules incl. 3 agree, 2 two-sided, sharp not VETOED, EV 2.5-15%): it recovers 54 of the 62 real auto bets (45 of the builder's 47 placeable). At the 24 h guard it would place 108 bets/31 games (47.9/day), CLV at the decision price +2.26% [+1.37,+3.24]; with the 6 h guard 76 (+3.05% [+2.39,+3.87]); with 6 h plus the falling-edge gate 73 bets/26 games (32.4/day), 70 closes +3.20% [+2.51,+4.05]; the bets the rule removes: 35 bets/18 games, 33 closes +0.20% [-2.92,+2.58]; kept-minus-dropped +3.01 pts [+0.62,+6.51]; CLV$ a day at quarter-Kelly: baseline $2.00, rule $1.87 (stake $91.5 -> $60.2 a day). The falling-edge gate removes 3 of 76 bets (CLV +1.49, -0.20, -2.83).
reason: From the feasibility and safety lens the COMBINED rule is not a credible improvement to put to Tj as one rule; only its 6 h half is feasible, and that half is already an open question with mixed evidence. (1) SAFETY: neither half loosens any limit (both only skip bets: the guard window tightens from 24 h to 6 h, the gate adds a skip reason); no safety limit is touched (daily limit, price tolerance, pregame only, halt on a lost order, sharp veto, trap guard's second rule all unchanged). (2) FEASIBILITY: the 6 h half is a setting that exists today (ScanSettings.trapEarlyHours, chip 6 in TrapGuard.EARLY_CHOICES; default TrapGuard.DEFAULT_EARLY_HOURS=6; the phone is at 24 h; Settings > Scanning trap guard card, Auto-bet tab, Bids tab; NOT part of PresetRules, so applying a preset will not set it). It is applied at decision time by AlertPicks.cnoCandidates (and TrapGuard.isEarly in runPinnacle), before the top-10 book-read cut (AutoScan.AUTO_BET_CHECK_TOP). The falling-edge half has no setting and needs new code: a new clause in AutoBet.judge(rules, shownEv, check, american, kind) using shownEv and check.ev, which the call already receives (AutoBettor.run line ~173), plus an AutoBet.Rules field, a ScanSettings field, a PresetRules field with a default, UI text, Diagnostics and tests; it does not apply to the Pinnacle-only path (runPinnacle has no book check) or to the 12 auto-bets of 74 in the window that carry no CNO record (11 Vigilant-scanner). No look-ahead: both inputs exist at decision time and the app only bets bets whose page it read. (3) THE FALLING-EDGE HALF IS A NEAR NO-OP AND ITS EVIDENCE IS NOT THE APP'S BETS: 11 of the 13 first-look flagged bets are already refused (agree<3 or sharp VETOED); it removes 2 of 47 placeable bets (4%), 2 of 62 real executed bets (3%; 3 of 99), 3 of 76 simulated; the CLV of what it removes rests on 2-3 closes. The builder's 10 within-6 h dropped closes (+3.83) come from bets the auto-bet would not place anyway. (4) THE UNIVERSE IS NOT WHAT THE APP DOES: first-look classification covers 35% of real executed bets; the app waits for the edge to cross 2.5% at the live price and the long-lead bets it executes beat the close by +1.85% (29 closes) at placement against +0.63% had they been bought at first look. The 6 h cut at first look drops all 46 first-listed >6 h bets; in the app 14 of them (30%) are still placed once inside 6 h. (5) THE DOLLAR CLAIM REVERSES AT DECISION TIME: the builder's 'CLV worth $1.96 a day instead of $1.11' needs the dropped bets to lose to the close (-2.44% on 16 closes). Executed, the dropped bets earned +1.67% (34 closes, CI [+0.24,+3.09]); realized CLV$ a day falls from $0.945 to $0.560 (real) or $2.00 to $1.87 (simulated) while bets fall 56% (real) or 32% (simulated) and stake 58% or 34%. The real cut in bets (56%) is 1.6x the builder's 36%. The real-bet kept-minus-dropped gap in the study window is +0.92 pts [-1.12,+3.29] (P<=0 0.18); only Oct 2 pre-window bets (the data that built the guard) give +6.78 [+2.15,+11.84]. (6) SIDE EFFECT: trapEarlyHours is ONE shared setting for auto-bet, alerts and bids; moving it to 6 h also stops maker bids beyond 6 h, and 8 of the 17 filled bids were posted >6 h out (CLV +3.5% on 7 closes vs +1.8% on 9 closes within 6 h; tiny, but nothing in the rule's evidence is about bids). (7) EVALUATION: all 75 universe bets are props; closes: Tracker 43 (only for bets that were placed), Novig trades 20, Pinnacle 1, none 11 (15%). Kept arm: 27 of 34 closes are Tracker (CNO books minutes before the start, the same family as the fair); on the 7 non-Tracker kept closes CLV is +1.50% (6 Novig-trade closes) and +2.14% (1 Pinnacle). Once a rule stops the app placing the dropped bets they get no Tracker close, so the dropped arm can only be measured by Novig-trade closes (>=3 trades). WHAT I WOULD PUT TO TJ INSTEAD (questions, not actions; both only tighten): (a) the trap guard 6 h vs 24 h stays the open question from the previous file, with the executed-bets evidence above (+0.87 pts [-1.16,+3.29] in the window; +1.68% on the 6-24 h executed bets) and the bids side effect; (b) do not build the falling-edge gate (2-3 bets in 2.3 days); (c) no code is needed to settle (a): every auto-bet record already carries minutesToStart, ev and checkEv, so the next file's auto-bets can be split by the rule's flags; if the true gap is 2 pts, about 26 games per arm (3 days at about 8.9 dropped-arm games a day, per-game SD 2.9 pts) to 108 (12 days, SD 5.9 incl. Oct 2 outliers); for 1 pt, 104 to 430 games (12 to 48 days).
caveats: The real-bet evidence (62 executed CNO auto-bets, 29 games, 2.1 days, one phone) overlaps the study's own bets and the kept/dropped CIs rest on 14 and 20 games: it weakens the case, it does not refute the 6 h guard (the guard was built from Tj's earlier 176 bets, RESEARCH.md 71, and the Oct 2 executed bets show +6.78 pts [+2.15,+11.84]).

Executed-bet CLV is Tracker CLV (CNO's books read before the start for a bet that was placed): the same family of books that produced the fair, so it measures how far CNO's consensus drifted toward Novig's price, not a sharp close; on props there is no Pinnacle close in 74 of 75 universe bets.

The decision-time simulation is mine: list presence from 'c' looks, page state from 'k' looks, the check fair carried forward and re-priced at each look's price, the sharp verdict taken from the latest 'k' look (not re-judged at a new price); it ignores the wallet, the cooldown, the per-cycle cap, 'a Novig price read in the last minute' and one-order-per-market, so it over-places (108 vs 62 real); it is an upper bound on volume, not a forecast.

Volume under a 6 h guard may be higher than the first-look 13.3 a day: the guard filters candidates BEFORE the top-10 page-read cut (AutoScan.cnoCandidates then take(10)), so read slots currently spent on 6-24 h bets go to nearer ones; 28 of 76 shown within-6 h bets (37%) never had a page read (12 closes, +2.67% [-0.13,+5.45]); at the placeable share (63%) that is up to about 7.8 more bets a day. The cost in bets is therefore bracketed, 32% (simulated) to 56% (real window).

The $5 a bet in the builder's 'at the caps' dollars is the API's per-bet cap; the auto-bet's own cap is $3.50 (autoBetMaxStake on the phone; real largest auto stake $2.90 in the window, median $1.60): the quarter-Kelly figures are the realistic ones. The $500 a day and $70 a game caps never bind for auto-bets (real window: $46 a day on average, largest day $57, largest auto exposure on one game $14.3; the larger day and game figures in the diagnostics include hand bets and bids).

Placement lag matters for every first-look figure in the study: 63 of 80 real auto-bets match a study bet and the median wait from first look to placement is 14.7 min (75th percentile 125 min, 90th 366 min); 18 of the 80 flagged auto (12 auto-bets with no CNO record, 11 of them Vigilant-scanner, and 6 bids) are outside the CNO auto-bet path this rule is about.
The two halves are unequal: in the placeable set the second half is 7 kept bets/4 games against 3 dropped/2 games (-9.46%, one of them the -30.6% long-lead bet).
Numbers-only: no bet rows, wallet balance, keys or ids are in this file.
